# Rolling-origin stability (generated by `scripts/run_rolling_origin.py`)

Git commit `aa9392d360`. Only data up to 2023-12-31 was loaded (no validation or test targets). MAE in MW; XGBoost and LSTM are the mean over 3 seeds of the per-seed MAE (range in brackets). Frozen configurations of each horizon (including the number of trees/epochs found on the main validation split) are re-used in every fold, so this tests the stability of the procedure across periods, not a re-tuned model. Fold 3 is the main split (validation 2024-H1), taken from the existing logs.

## Horizon 1 h

| fold | train / eval samples | best naive | ridge | XGBoost S4 | LSTM L4 | XGBoost vs ridge | LSTM vs XGBoost |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| fold 1 (train to 2022-12, eval 2023-H1) | 11,130 / 4,343 | 4,198 | 1,111 | 1,199 (1,192-1,208) | 1,627 (1,560-1,755) | +88 | +428 |
| fold 2 (train to 2023-06, eval 2023-H2) | 15,473 / 4,414 | 3,973 | 1,021 | 1,051 (1,047-1,055) | 1,392 (1,362-1,424) | +30 | +341 |
| fold 3 = main split (validation 2024-H1) | 19,887 / 4,367 | 4,430 | 1,089 | 1,112 | 1,659 | +23 | +547 |

## Horizon 48 h

| fold | train / eval samples | best naive | ridge | XGBoost S4 | LSTM L4 | XGBoost vs ridge | LSTM vs XGBoost |

| fold 2 (train to 2023-06, eval 2023-H2) | 15,413 / 4,414 | 6,461 | 5,307 | 4,877 (4,836-4,952) | 5,303 (5,152-5,420) | -430 | +426 |

Differences are in MW (negative = first model better). Only three folds of half a year each, with one set of frozen hyper-parameters; the table shows whether the ranking of the models is stable, not a significance test.
